name: Eye of Skadi
description: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.
trivia: Skaði (Skadi) is the Goddess of Winter in Norse mythology.
Skaði (Skadi) means "damage" or "harm" in Old Norse and Icelandic, pronounced "Skathi".
Þjazi (Thiazi), Skadi's father in Norse mythology, had his eyes placed in the night sky as stars.
